jobs.title: Sr. Software Dev Engineer, Ring Cloud Connectivity Org
jobs.jd:
Ring is seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer to join the Cloud Connectivity organization in Toronto, where you'll lead the design and delivery of large-scale, customer-facing platforms that power how millions of Ring devices and services work together.

You'll own the end-to-end technical direction for complex systems that process high-throughput real-time data and integrate with a broad ecosystem of connected devices. You'll collaborate across Ring's cloud, firmware, science, and product organizations to solve hard problems in distributed systems, cross-platform application delivery, and real-time data processing at scale.

This role offers the opportunity to shape new product experiences from the ground up, working with a Toronto-based team that values technical ownership, iterative delivery, AI-first development practices, and engineering excellence.

Join us in building the next generation of smart home infrastructure that keeps families safe and connected.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead the design and architecture of large-scale, customer-facing platforms supporting millions of Ring devices with strict availability and latency requirements
- Leverage and champion AI-first development practices across the engineering lifecycle — including design, code generation, testing, code review, and debugging
- Architect fault-tolerant distributed systems using AWS services, ensuring scalability from thousands to millions of concurrent operations
- Design and build high-throughput, low-latency data processing pipelines that aggregate and serve real-time signals from diverse device types
- Drive technical roadmap and iterative feature delivery for multi-year programs with leadership visibility
- Partner with science and ML teams to integrate model outputs into production customer-facing applications
- Mentor and grow other SDEs, setting the bar for technical quality, design rigor, and operational ownership
- Influence technical decision-making across Ring's connected home platform, contributing to architecture reviews and long-term technology strategy

About the team
Ring Cloud Connectivity builds the foundational platforms and services that power how Ring devices connect, communicate, coordinate, and deliver experiences to customers. The team partners across Ring's cloud services, firmware, science, and product organizations to deliver customer experiences at scale. We are a Toronto-based team that values technical ownership, iterative delivery, and leveraging AI-first development to maximize engineering impact.

Basic qualifications:
- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming using a modern programming language such as Java, C++, or C#, including object-oriented design experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
- Experience with Generative AI-first development practices
- 2+ years Experience with one or more relevant front-end frameworks such as React, React Native, or cross-platform UI toolkits

Preferred qualifications:
- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience with real-time data processing, streaming architectures, or low-latency event-driven systems.
- Experience integrating ML or computer vision model outputs into production applications.

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer, ML Platform & Infrastructure
jobs.jd:
BUILD SOMETHING PEOPLE LOVE

Wealthsimple is Canada’s leading financial innovator. The company offers a full suite of simple, sophisticated financial products across managed investing, do-it-yourself trading, cryptocurrency, tax filing, spending and saving. Wealthsimple currently serves more than 4 million Canadians and holds over $155 billion in assets under administration. The company was founded in 2014 by a team of financial experts and technology entrepreneurs, and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.



We're proud of what we've built — and we're just getting started. Read our Culture Manual https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/culture and learn more about how we work https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/careers.




ML PLATFORM & INFRASTRUCTURE TEAM

The Machine Learning Infrastructure & Platform team builds the foundational architecture powering AI and GenAI initiatives across Wealthsimple. We sit at the intersection of production MLOps and cutting-edge GenAI enablement.

As our AI footprint expands rapidly, our priority is evolving our robust MLOps foundations into a scalable, high-performance LLM serving and routing platform. We build self-serve systems that allow Data Scientists and Engineers to host open-source LLMs reliably, optimize inference latencies, manage GPU infrastructure, and benchmark model performance safely in production.




THE ROLE

We are looking for an experienced MLOps or ML Platform Engineer who is excited to pivot their deep background in model orchestration, serving, and platform tooling toward solving the unique challenges of LLM inference and infrastructure.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between traditional MLOps (model lifecycles, pipeline orchestration, serving infrastructure) and modern GenAI stack requirements (vLLM, GPU cluster management, intelligent model routing, and automated Evals). You will take end-to-end ownership of setting the technical direction for operating enterprise-grade LLM systems company-wide.





IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO:

 - Turn MLOps expertise to GenAI: Transition traditional ML lifecycle and serving patterns into state-of-the-art LLM inference engines and GPU orchestration systems.

 - Build model-routing architecture: Design low-latency routing frameworks (e.g., LiteLLM integration) to dynamically direct requests across managed cloud providers (AWS Bedrock) and self-hosted open-source models.

 - Provision & scale GPU infrastructure: Architect and manage high-performance GPU serving environments on Kubernetes using engines like vLLM, Ray, and Triton.

 - Develop evaluation & benchmarking tooling: Build automated Evals and observability frameworks to empower engineers and data scientists to validate model quality, latency, and drift against production requirements.

 - Empower self-serve ML across Wealthsimple: Partner with product engineering and data science teams to build framework-agnostic platform tooling that abstracts infrastructure complexity.

 - Drive cost & performance optimization: Improve price-performance across self-hosted and managed inference by optimizing capacity, utilization, batching, routing, and model selection while meeting quality and reliability objectives




WE ARE LOOKING FOR PEOPLE WHO HAVE:

 - 7+ years of software engineering experience in ML Infrastructure, MLOps, ML Tooling, or Data Platform engineering.

 - Deep experience in MLOps/ML Platform practices: Proven track record building and operating self-serve ML platforms, model registry workflows, experiment tracking, or production serving infrastructure (Kubeflow, MLflow, Ray, Triton, SageMaker).

 - Strong platform fundamentals: Advanced proficiency in Python, container orchestration via Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), and cloud provider ecosystem (AWS).

 - Strong appetite to specialize in LLM serving: A genuine desire to leverage your existing MLOps skillset to tackle LLM-specific challenges (vLLM, model routing, prompt engineering tooling, vector databases, GPU memory optimization, or LLM evaluation frameworks).

 - Backend performance & observability focus: Experience designing highly available, observable microservices (e.g., FastAPI) handling real-time, low-latency requests.

 - End-to-end technical ownership: Proven capability to lead architectural roadmaps, guide multi-functional projects with high autonomy, and maintain complex platform systems for the long run.




NICE-TO-HAVES (OR AREAS YOU WILL LEARN ON THE JOB):

 - Direct experience serving open-source Large Language Models in production (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Dynamo).

 - Hands-on work with CUDA, GPU partitioning, or distributed inference frameworks (Ray Serve).

 - Familiarity with vector search and retrieval engines (Elasticsearch, Qdrant, Pinecone).




OUR STACK INCLUDES:

 - Container & Infrastructure: Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS GPU Infrastructure

 - ML Serving & LLM Tooling: vLLM, Ray, Triton, LiteLLM, AWS Bedrock, MLflow, SageMaker

 - Languages & Frameworks: Python, FastAPI, PyTorch

 - Data & Streaming: Kafka, Postgres, Redshift, Snowflake




WHY WEALTHSIMPLE?

🌸 Top-tier health benefits and life insurance

📈 Long-term group savings with employer match, through Wealthsimple for Business

🌴 20 vacation days, 4 wellness days, and unlimited sick and mental health days per year*

✈️ 90 days away: work outside Canada for up to 90 days per year*

👥 Employee resource groups, including Rainbow (2SLGBTQ), Women of WS, and Black at WS

🌎 We are a hybrid team with over 1,500 employees across North America. The people are one of the best parts of working here: you'll collaborate with incredibly talented, curious, and driven teammates who are deeply committed to doing great work.

*Unlimited paid sick days, Wellness Days and the 90 day away program do not apply to certain roles. 




ICYMI

Technology & Innovation at Wealthsimple: We move quickly and build thoughtfully. That means we're always looking for better ways to work

Come and build the future with us as we change the way the world sees the Cloud!

CloudWatch is the observability platform of AWS, built for developers, system operators, site reliability engineers (SRE), and IT managers. CloudWatch collects monitoring and operational data in the form of logs, metrics, and events, providing a unified view of AWS resources, applications and services that run on AWS, and on-premises servers. Customers use CloudWatch to set high resolution alarms, visualise logs and metrics side by side, take automated actions, troubleshoot issues, and discover insights to optimise their applications, and ensure they are running smoothly. The CloudWatch team in Dublin is growing and we are looking for an exceptional senior software development engineer to create the next generation CloudWatch experience.

CloudWatch is one of the largest real time data platforms in the world, processing more than 13 quadrillion metric observations per month! This requires teams in CloudWatch to innovate at an unprecedented scale. In CloudWatch we love giving customers what they want: high quality, highly usable, highly available services. It's humbling and energizing to work with excellent, dedicated engineers to build and deliver world-leading service monitoring solutions at AWS scale.

We're looking for a new teammate who is enthusiastic, empathetic, curious, motivated, reliable, and able to work effectively with a diverse team of peers; someone who will help us amplify the positive & inclusive team culture we've been building.

Cloud watch is a part team is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) which provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

Key job responsibilities
As a Senior Software Development Engineer for the CloudWatch organisation, you will lead the design and architecture of highly available, massively scaled systems used by millions of users worldwide and spanning multiple services and teams. You will shape the technical strategy and roadmap for the services you and your team own, making and documenting the key architectural decisions and tradeoffs, and you will stay hands-on — building our telemetry collection agents in Rust and Go and engaging with the upstream open-source communities, such as OpenTelemetry, that our software is built on and contributes to.

You will raise the engineering bar across the team through code and design reviews, coding standards, and operational excellence, and help expand our services across all AWS Regions. When issues arise, you will dive deep to understand the root cause and drive fixes that prevent them recurring. Above all, you will mentor and develop the engineers around you, growing the technical capability of the team, and partner with product and other engineering teams to break ambiguous problems down into deliverable workstreams. You will champion the adoption of GenAI and AI-powered development tools across the team, raising engineering productivity while staying current with emerging technologies.

Our team owns telemetry collection for CloudWatch, building and operating the agents that gather metrics, logs, and traces at AWS scale.

jobs.jd:
Amazon's CloudTune organization is seeking a Software Development Engineer to join the Scaling Planner team and contribute to our suite of products across Reactive and Proactive Scaling. Our systems automate capacity management for thousands of EC2-based Auto Scaling Groups across Amazon's Stores, Devices, and Other (SDO) organization.

Proactive Scaling is the forward-looking engine at the core of Scaling Planner - it ingests business forecasts, applies scaling formulas via the Capacity Calculator, and generates capacity recommendations before demand arrives. This is how Amazon prepares for its highest-stakes moments, including Prime Day, Black Friday, and other High Volume Events. Reactive Scaling is the backstop to unplanned changes in demand - when systems come under stress that scaling can help smooth, we step in and provide automated emergency relief by pulling from a centrally managed capacity pool when real-time metric thresholds are breached.

As an Software Development Engineer II, you will own the design, delivery, and operation of systems across this portfolio with a primary focus on Proactive Scaling. You will partner with scientists, capacity managers, and service owners to ensure Amazon's infrastructure is always right-sized at the right time - powering services behind Amazon.com, Alexa, Prime Video, and digital devices.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the design, implementation, and operation of Proactive Scaling services that generate capacity recommendations using business forecasts, scaling formulas, and the Capacity Calculator.
- Build and improve the automated pipeline that calculates, schedules, and applies capacity overrides for peak events and daily scaling across supported regions (IAD, PDX, DUB, FRA, ZAZ).
- Contribute to Reactive Scaling systems that monitor real-time metrics (CPU, throughput via CloudWatch and PMET) and automatically adjust capacity when thresholds are breached.
- Drive integration between Scaling Planner, the Capacity Calculator (formerly CloudSpin), Fleet Management Console, and CloudTune Capacity Service to deliver seamless, end-to-end capacity automation.
- Define and monitor risk factors, efficiency metrics, and guardrails that trigger iterative improvements with customers to close automation gaps.
- Lead technical design reviews, author design documents, and influence the architectural direction of Scaling Planner.
- Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, design guidance, and operational best practices.
- Maintain high operational standards, including on-call responsibilities, monitoring, alarming, and incident response for services you own.

About the team
Scaling Planner is CloudTune's capacity automation engine for Amazon's SDO organization. We ensure that thousands of EC2-based services have the right capacity at the right time - whether that means proactively scaling up for Prime Day or reactively absorbing an unexpected traffic surge. Our Proactive Scaling capability is what sets us apart: instead of reacting to traffic spikes, we predict them using advanced forecasting and automatically prepare infrastructure weeks in advance. Reactive Scaling complements this by providing an automated safety net when real-world conditions deviate from forecasts. We work closely with CloudTune Science, capacity management, and service owners across Amazon. jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Transactional Data Storage
jobs.jd:
Do you want to work deep inside a database that processes billions of transactions every day across Amazon's consumer and digital businesses? Our team builds the data platforms at the core of Amazon, storing customer orders, catalog and product information, shopping carts, device data, and hundreds of other business-critical datasets. The performance and availability of our platform is critical to the reliability of the Amazon brand, and we run some of the largest fleets and highest-throughput services at the company.

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer who understands distributed systems at scale and wants to shape the shared storage layer of our next-generation online transaction processing (OLTP) database. You will design how committed transactions are materialized to cloud object storage, how space is reclaimed as data is superseded, and how data nodes read back through a storage-format-agnostic contract. You will partner with Amazon Web Services (AWS) to leverage cloud-native technologies and contribute innovations back to the broader market. If you thrive on solving ambiguous, high-impact problems from design to delivery, we would love to hear from you.

- Design, develop, and operate the distributed shared storage layer that holds the durable copy of every committed write for Amazon's mission-critical OLTP database platform.

- Own end-to-end delivery of features, from writing design documents and implementing production-quality code to driving operational readiness and deployment.
- Mentor engineers through design and code reviews, pairing on hard problems, and helping them take on larger pieces of the system while raising the team's quality bar.

You will split your time between deep individual work like writing code, reviewing designs, and prototyping storage-layer changes, and collaborative sessions with your team and partner teams. Expect regular design reviews where you debate trade-offs around durability, latency, and cost, along with weekly operational reviews that keep the platform healthy. We are a group of engineers who care deeply about correctness, performance, and operational rigor. We partner closely with AWS service teams, sharing innovations in both directions.  System Architecture, Data Flows & Databases

 Local Team Leadership & Operational Readiness

 Observability , Monitoring & Reliability

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, Umbrella Training
jobs.jd:
The Umbrella Training team is looking for a Software Development Engineer to join our mission-critical platform that powers training for Amazon's global fulfillment network. This unique role impacts millions — over 2 million Associates trained annually across 5,740 global sites. Your code will literally shape people's first day at Amazon and their ability to safely perform their jobs.

Unlike traditional software engineering positions, you'll tackle full-stack complexity at an exceptional scale, working across 40 serverless pipelines, three distinct training modalities, and integrations with dozens of tool teams. You'll architect solutions spanning from Lambda functions processing millions of requests daily to user interfaces serving 70,000+ trainers, while balancing technical constraints with legal, HR, and operational requirements. This role requires exceptional attention to operational excellence and careful risk management, as your deployments affect real-time operations at thousands of warehouses simultaneously.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and develop maintainable, scalable software solutions across the full technology stack, from database schemas and Lambda functions to user interfaces and external integrations that support millions of Associates globally.
- Participate actively in the code review process, providing meaningful feedback to teammates and ensuring high-quality code standards across the Umbrella LMS platform.
- Architect and implement solutions that balance complex technical requirements with business needs, translating between technical architecture and operational impact.
- Contribute to the full software development lifecycle including scoping, design, coding, testing, deployment, and maintenance of mission-critical training systems.
- Demonstrate operational excellence by identifying and resolving root causes of operational issues, while continuously improving monitoring systems and documentation for a platform supporting thousands of fulfillment sites worldwide.

A day in the life
Your day might begin with reviewing a teammate's pull request for a critical service component, offering constructive feedback on their approach. You could then investigate performance issues across AWS Lambda functions serving thousands of sites globally. By midday, you might join a design discussion with Instructional Designers and learning execution teams, balancing compliance requirements with innovative features for a platform supporting hundreds of thousands of users. Later, you'll implement new features in TypeScript, write tests, and configure monitoring dashboards to track performance across different regions. Throughout the day, you'll switch between backend integration work and frontend improvements, while mentoring junior engineers through code reviews. Before wrapping up, you'll document your technical decisions in the team's knowledge base and troubleshoot emerging issues before they affect Associates relying on the platform.

About the team
The Umbrella Training team builds and maintains the Umbrella Learning Management System (LMS), a mission-critical platform that powers training for Amazon's global fulfillment network. Our system is often the first interaction new associates have with Amazon, delivering training to over 2 million associates annually across 5,740 sites worldwide. The Umbrella LMS delivers 97% of Associate training hours and 60% of training hours across all levels at Amazon, making it essential infrastructure for the world's largest fulfillment network. Our team tackles complex challenges at massive scale, balancing technical innovation with operational excellence to ensure reliable, efficient training delivery that directly impacts Amazon's operational capabilities.

Basic qualifications:
- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications:
- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Fulfillment Technology (AFT), Platform Engineering and Services
jobs.jd:
Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) powers the physical engine at the heart of Amazon — magically turning your click of a button into packages at your door. Within AFT, the Labor Insights team builds and operates the platform that tracks on associate labor performance across Amazon's entire global warehouse network. Labor Insights' suite of 18+ services supports ~1 million associates and 70,000+ daily portal users across 9,800+ facilities and 10 business lines — ingesting over 19 billion labor events annually to produce the real-time productivity reports that warehouse managers rely on to run their operations every day. We leverage AWS technologies, stream processing, and AI/ML to build distributed, highly available systems that operate at massive scale.

As a Software Development Engineer on the Labor Insights team, you will build the next generation of Amazon's labor management platform — designing systems that ingest billions of labor events from warehouse floor tools and time clock systems, aggregate them through multi-stage pipelines, and serve real-time productivity reports to operations managers across the globe. You will own design and development of distributed systems that refresh reports every 10–15 minutes across 3 global regions while maintaining 99.9% availability. You will contribute to a wide range of projects — from event processing pipelines and aggregation engines to reporting APIs, modern React-based portals, and AI-powered configuration tools. * Identify technical and project risks and take initiative to mitigate them

Full-cycle ownership. You contribute to all aspects of the software development cycle — from scoping and design through implementation, testing, and delivery of features that provide labor performance visibility to Amazon's global fulfillment operations.

You design multi-stage aggregation pipelines that process this data into PPR and PPA reports refreshed every 10–15 minutes, served to 70K+ daily users across 9,800+ facilities.

AWS-native architecture. You leverage the full AWS stack — DynamoDB for hot data storage, S3 for historical data, PostgreSQL for aggregated reports, SQS/SNS for event-driven processing, EventBridge and Lambda for serverless job orchestration, and Cosmos/Flink for stream processing. You architect for 99.9% availability across 3 global regions (NA, EU, FE).
AI-first development. You pioneer AI-assisted engineering practices — using Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Q, and AI-powered tools to accelerate greenfield development at 20X traditional velocity. You build intelligent systems like AI-powered configuration assistants, automated intake routing, and GenAI-driven operational tooling.

Modernization at scale. You modernize a 15+ year-old platform serving every fulfillment center worldwide — consolidating 23+ services into a clean microservices architecture, rebuilding the portal experience in React from legacy JSP/jQuery, and transitioning from batch to stream processing, all while maintaining zero-downtime operations.

As a Senior Member of Technical Staff (SMTS) within our Monitoring Cloud team, you will be a key owner and operator of the systems that keep Salesforce reliable. Your mission is to bridge the gap between high-level feature design and deep-system stability. From automating the "paved path" across AWS and GCP to securing air-gap environments for our most sensitive customers, you will ensure our monitoring stack is invisible, resilient, and intelligent.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer - Payments Products & Platform
jobs.location: AU: Sydney (45 Clarence St) | AU: Melbourne: (260 Burwood Rd) | Sydney, Australia
jobs.jd:
THE ROLE

 

Xero reimagined accounting software. Now we’re reimagining how small businesses get paid and how money moves. We're making a critical, multi-year investment in two connected engineering portfolios, Payments Products & Experiences and Payments Platform, and we're hiring a Principal Engineer for each. As our three-year payments strategy reaches a turning point, you'll help shape what comes next, with domain-level influence over the next two to three years.

 

You'll shape technical strategy across multiple teams, partnering with senior stakeholders to turn complex requirements into scalable, resilient systems. Staying close to the technical detail, you'll set the example for a portfolio of 40 to 50 engineers. You'll also join a global community of Principal Engineers across Xero, driving engineering standards, architecture, and best practices.

 

You'll Go Bold by setting long-term direction, and Go Together by bringing product, engineering and senior stakeholders with you.

 


THE TEAMS

Payments Products & Experiences: this portfolio is made up of our Get Paid and Growth teams, builds the checkout, payment methods, flexible payments and AI payment agents that help small businesses get paid on time. 

 

Payments Platform: this portfolio is the engine underneath, with provider integrations, bill payments and a single, product-agnostic API that other Xero teams build on. 

 

Together they move billions of dollars across more than 150,000 transactions a day, a number set to double as we grow into the UK and US.

 


THE TEAMS ARE CURRENTLY WORKING ON

 - Tech stack: microservices across web, API and data layers, built in languages such as C#, Java, Go or C++, running on AWS with SQL and NoSQL data stores.

 - Current focus: reviewing existing payments systems to work out what to extend, migrate or rebuild, alongside Growth experiments and AI-powered payment chasing.

 - Future focus: a multi-year payments architecture covering agentic payment workflows, payments inside AI assistants and recurring payments.

 - Global scale: replatforming payment methods and designing global rails and a ledger ready for new markets.
   
    


WHERE AND HOW YOU CAN WORK

You'll be based in Sydney or Melbourne, working a hybrid model that blends time together in our modern offices with the flexibility of working from home. Boost days bring teams together to connect and collaborate in person. With colleagues across Australia and the US and payment flows that run around the clock, you'll also work across time zones.

 


SOME OF THE THINGS WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - You bring deep experience designing and running large-scale distributed systems in production, balancing reliability, performance and cost, and any payments or fintech experience is a real plus.

 - API-first thinking is second nature, and you're at home across web, API and data layers, with fluency in at least one modern backend language, SQL and NoSQL stores, and cloud-native platforms, ideally AWS.

 - Legacy-heavy systems are a puzzle you enjoy, and you make clear, practical calls on whether to extend, migrate or build while staying hands-on through pairing, spikes and code.

 - A strong interest in utilising AI tooling is essential, as you will model how to use these technologies to automate tasks and improve engineering outcomes.

 - Your background shows a deep curiosity for growth hacking and a proven ability to design and analyse A/B tests that drive product usage.

 - You'll Go Further by mentoring Staff and Senior engineers, shaping cross-team initiatives with Xero's Principal community and setting standards that lift engineering across Xero.
   
    

Apply even if your experience isn't a perfect match! At Xero, we hire based on your skills, passion, and the unique perspective you can bring to enhance our culture and team.

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

 The Card Loan Platform team builds the high-throughput decision engine at the heart of Affirm’s card products. Unlike traditional cards, every pay-later transaction is backed by its own unique loan, and our system is the "invisible piping" that makes this complex model work at scale. Every swipe triggers our platform to solve a hard problem in milliseconds: matching messy, fragmented payment network data to the correct loan to drive real-time approvals, origination, and refunds.

 As Affirm experiences explosive growth, our team's contributions are a key enabler. This isn't just another backend role; you'll be building the "financial brain" for our flagship card products, with your work on the critical path for every single swipe. We're tackling a unique, high-stakes distributed systems challenge that demands exceptional correctness and massive scale. You will partner closely with product, data science, and engineering teams to design and build the future of our industry-leading money movement platform.

 If you are passionate about making foundational design decisions and building a beloved, lasting financial brand—come join us. It’s going to be an amazing ride!

 What you'll do 

- Drive technical strategy by leading the planning, prioritization, and execution of projects, ensuring alignment with product, technical, and business goals.

- Lead the end-to-end system design and development of large-scale, high-availability services. This includes building robust APIs and data models for our micro-service and event-driven architectures.

- Collaborate across functions with partners in Product, Analytics, Design, Legal, and Accounting and to define requirements and execute our card loan attribution and lifecycle strategy.

- Ensure system health and performance by analyzing and troubleshooting complex technical issues, optimizing existing code, and driving solutions that focus on long-term robustness and scalability.

- Mentor and grow the team by guiding junior engineers, leading technical discussions and design reviews, and championing best practices through code review.

 What we look for 

- 5+ years of experience in software development or engineering, with a deep understanding of system design and architecture.

- Motivated leader, inspiring team growth and fostering a culture of continuous learning

jobs.jd:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

 The Data and Storage Services team is responsible for Affirm's data infrastructure across OLTP and OLAP systems, spanning critical online checkout databases, batch orchestration, streaming infrastructure, event-driven frameworks, BI, analytics tooling, large-scale data platforms, and agentic data tools such as semantic layers and internal platform data applications. Our mission is to provide trustworthy, intuitive, and cost-efficient solutions for Affirmers to secure, store, analyze, and transform data at exceptional scale.

 The Online Storage team provides a set of managed databases as a platform, used to persist data for all Affirm services. Our platform enables self-service access to OLTP storage systems, including Relational DB(MySQL), KV(DynamoDB), Distributed SQL(TiDB) and Cache(Redis). As a team, we are responsible for various data and access patterns, including but not limited to mission-critical financial transactional data, data science models, and any new persistence use case. These responsibilities require us to learn and gain deep expertise in various database systems. 

 We are looking for a talented Senior Software Engineer who can architect, build and scale Relational and Distributed SQL Databases identifying opportunities to improve how we build, productionize, operate and improve this mission-critical infrastructure to unlock substantial value within our business. You’ll have the opportunity to directly influence your team’s roadmap in close collaboration with your peers, share your knowledge and expertise with others and learn from some of the best on our shared mission to deliver honest financial products that improve lives.

 What you’ll do 

- You will build and operate the control plane for large-scale distributed SQL databases such as MySQL and TiDB, automating provisioning, failover, backups and upgrades end to end.

- You will design and execute reliability-focused schema and data migrations across multi-tenant database clusters, with zero downtime for the products that depend on them.

- You will own the networking stack that connects services to storage on Kubernetes, including connection proxies such as ProxySQL, and tune it for latency, resilience and failover.

- You will be responsible for owning and delivering quarterly goals for your team, leading engineers on your team through ambiguity to solve open-ended problems, and ensuring that everyone is supported throughout delivery.

- You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.

- You will proactively identify project, process, technology or business issues, advocate for them, and lead in solving them.

- You will support the operations and availability of your team’s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.

- You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting or improving code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.

- You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.

 What we look for 

- You have a total of 5+ years of experience as a software engineer.

- You are experienced in designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale technologies like Python, Kotlin, AWS, MySQL, Terraform and Kubernetes.

- You have in-depth, hands-on experience with large-scale database deployments in a production environment.

- You have expertise in distributed databases and database technologies such as MySQL(Preferred), TiDB(Preferred), Postgres, Spanner, Vitess, CockroachDB etc.

- Solid understanding of distributed database architecture, data modeling, and performance tuning. Particularly, expertise in SQL tuning and performance optimization techniques.

- You have expertise in database benchmarking, load testing, and capacity planning.

- You are familiar with connection poolers and proxies such as ProxySQL, RDS Proxy, Pg Bouncer, PgDog etc.

- You have built control-plane or automation tooling for databases, such as provisioning, failover, upgrades or schema migrations, ideally on Kubernetes.

- You have executed zero-downtime migrations and major version upgrades on production databases, and have built CLI tooling or runbooks to make those procedures repeatable.

- You understand Kubernetes networking, service discovery and TLS well enough to debug connection and failover problems between services and databases.

- You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, simple and extensible design. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.

- You are proficient at making significant changes in a large code base, and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely.

- Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.

- You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.

- This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

 This remote role is open only to candidates residing in Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Newfoundland and Labrador, Nova Scotia, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, or Saskatchewan.

Equity Grade - 6

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, WW Prime Tech
jobs.jd:
Build the technology that shows hundreds of millions of shoppers what an Amazon Prime membership would actually be worth to them. We want a Software Development Engineer who enjoys large-scale distributed systems and personalization work, where the outcome is measured in members gained.

Prime is among the largest paid membership programs in the world, with members in 26 countries. Most people decide whether to join in the few seconds they spend on a single page, so which benefit we choose to show them, and when, decides the outcome. Our team owns the value messaging across every Prime upsell — every place Amazon offers a membership to a shopper — on Amazon's highest-traffic retail pages, in our mobile apps, and increasingly on channels beyond Amazon, including display advertising, social media, and partner sites. We are building those channels out for new member acquisition first, then across the full Prime member lifecycle.

As an engineer on the team, you will design, build, and operate backend services that personalize these experiences at high request volumes and low latency. You will own what you build from design through production, and work day to day with product managers, designers, and applied scientists to run experiments across countries and turn what you learn into experiences shoppers see within the same quarter.

There is a great deal still to build. We are moving these decisions from rules to learned ranking, and building the tooling that lets a new experience launch worldwide in days instead of months. If you want hard technical problems with a short path to real customers, you will enjoy this team.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and operate the low-latency services that decide which Prime value message a customer sees, on Amazon's highest-traffic pages across 26 countries.
- Build the data pipelines and third-party integrations that carry Prime value messaging to channels beyond Amazon, including display advertising, social media, and partner sites.
- Move message ranking from rules to learned ranking, working with applied scientists on the signals, the serving path, and how results get measured.
- Replace manual launch steps with configuration and tooling so new messaging ships in days, and run the live experiments that tell us whether it worked.
- Own your services end to end: design, implementation, deployment, operational health, and readiness for the traffic peaks of Prime Day and the holidays.
- Start from broadly defined problems and turn them into designs and code your teammates can build on.

A day in the life
No day looks like the last. Most mix heads-down building with the people you build it for: you might open with the health of your services and the numbers from a live experiment, then design the next message with a product manager and an applied scientist. You'll be in code and in reviews, digging into a latency or reliability question, and working with partner teams across Prime to reach customers somewhere new. Because we ship and experiment constantly, you'll see a change you made go live in a dozen countries, then watch data tell you whether you were right.

About the team
We're the team that decides how Prime's value reaches people who haven't joined yet — on every surface where Amazon offers a membership, and now beyond Amazon in advertising, social, and partner channels. The aim is that every customer sees the one reason a membership is worth it to them: their delivery speed, their savings, their shopping. We settle arguments with experiments, not opinions, and we care as much about how a message reads as how the service holds at peak. We're small for the ground we cover, so ownership comes early, and we value engineers who make their teammates better.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer , Network Monitoring and Remediation
jobs.jd:
Amazon is looking for Software Development Engineers to build the software that monitors one of the world’s largest and most complex networks. Tens of millions of customers rely on Amazon’s network for using our retail websites, accessing content on their Kindles and building applications and businesses on top of Amazon Web Services (AWS). Our goal is to become The Infrastructure Platform for the world – achieving this goal requires high-leverage, massively scalable software systems. Our success depends on our world-class network infrastructure, and our network depends on our Network Monitoring and Remediation team.

In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud's network healthy. We build the near-real-time probing, telemetry processing, and triangulation infrastructure that continuously measures the performance and availability of every path across the Amazon network. When something degrades, our systems pinpoint the problem in seconds and drive automated remediation, so our customers keep uninterrupted access to the innovation they rely on. We work on some of the hardest problems in distributed systems and observability, operating at a scale where billions of measurements turn into actionable signal, and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

Senior Software Engineer, Backend (Retail DEX)

 We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join the Retail DEX team within the Consumer & Business group. This team runs all the data and trading systems that power onchain ("DEX") trading within the main Coinbase app, enabling millions of traders to buy and sell 70M+ tokens on major blockchains including Base and Solana. You'll build software systems that straddle the off-chain and onchain worlds to deliver a seamless, unified trading experience regardless of where an asset settles.

- Integrate new blockchains, decentralized exchanges, and launchpads into the main Coinbase app to unlock more onchain assets for millions of traders

- Design and implement first-party smart contracts for onchain trading primitives such as DEX aggregation and advanced order types to improve execution quality and capability

- Scale real-time data pipelines to handle 100K+ messages per second, enabling millisecond-latency processing of blockchain market data

- Optimize the trading stack end-to-end to deliver the fastest execution, most optimal fills, and most comprehensive asset coverage for DEX traders

- Drive iteration on agentic-first development patterns, building self-improving software systems and tooling that accelerate team velocity

 Required Skills and Experience: 

- 5+ years of experience in backend software engineering with demonstrated success building and operating data systems or data pipelines in production

- Hands-on experience designing data-intensive systems and integrating with large-scale data infrastructure such as Kafka, Clickhouse, Starrocks, Temporal, and Redis

- Proven experience designing and integrating with onchain smart contracts on EVM (Ethereum, Base) or Solana, with deep understanding of the programming models of one or more of these virtual machines

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Security Epoxy
jobs.jd:
Amazon Security operates at a scale few engineers ever get to work at. Epoxy is the team that builds the automation making that coverage possible. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to support the building and operating of the platforms that onboard threat detection, remediate security risk, and accelerate security response across every AWS account.

AWS Security, Epoxy builds a collection of automation platforms for AWS Security. We enable threat detection across a large fleet of AWS accounts (onboarding coverage, auditing it continuously, and making findings available to partner teams), we help partner teams remediate detected risks and respond to incidents automatically at scale, and we run the foundational services (communications, workflow orchestration, data enrichment, and secure access) that the rest of AWS Security][ operations relies on. Our systems operate at very high scale and carry a high operational bar: you build it, you run it.

You are a Software Development Engineer who enjoys taking a difficult, loosely specified problem and turning it into a well designed, thoroughly tested, and cleanly operated system. You care about the quality of what you ship and about leaving the systems you touch better than you found them. Experience in security is a plus, but it is not a requirement: what matters most is that you build robust, maintainable, high quality software using modern practices and technologies such as AWS services, Python, and TypeScript, and that you take ownership of the operational health of what you deliver.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and deliver features and components that solve difficult problems across AWS Security Epoxy's services, working independently from a well understood business goal even when the implementation is not fully specified.
- Own the operational excellence of the systems you work on: instrument them, alarm on the right signals, and drive down operational load through automation rather than manual toil.
- Write high quality, well tested code that meets a high engineering bar, and clear documentation and runbooks that let others maintain and extend your work.
- Participate in the team on-call rotation, supporting our services and responding to high-severity requests from AWS Security operations and Partner Teams. You resolve issues, then eliminate their contributing causes with permanent fixes.
- Improve the resiliency, scalability, and safety of systems that operate at very high scale, making sound trade-offs between short-term needs and long-term maintainability.
- Raise the bar through code reviews, design reviews, operational readiness reviews, and post-incident analyses, giving useful and actionable feedback including to more senior engineers.
- Mentor newer teammates and interns, and begin to influence partner teams by helping them adopt sound engineering and operational practices.

A day in the life
You pick up a feature request on one of Epoxy's services, break it into deliverable pieces, and ship it incrementally with tests and monitoring in place.

You review a teammate's design, ask the questions that surface a hidden resiliency risk, and help simplify the approach before code is written.

On an on-call week, you triage a high-severity issue, mitigate customer impact quickly, then open the follow-up work to make sure that class of failure cannot recur.

You spot a piece of manual operational work your team repeats every week and replace it with automation, giving the whole team time back.

You sync with a partner detection or response team to understand how they use an Epoxy capability, and feed what you learn back into the roadmap.

Why Amazon Security?

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon's products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Training & Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve.

jobs.jd:
Role Description 

 As a Senior Client Platform Engineer on CorpFleet Engineering, you will own and improve Dropbox’s Windows endpoint platform. You will bring deep Windows and Intune expertise, make patching and application delivery more reliable, and build automation that reduces recurring work for the team.

 This is a hands-on role combining Windows technical ownership with the development of a more code-managed endpoint platform. You will help evaluate and adopt FleetDM, osquery, infrastructure-as-code, and GitOps practices where they improve reliability, visibility, and maintainability. You will strengthen the current environment while building and validating the path forward—not assume that replacing a tool is the answer.

 You will work with CorpInfra, IAM, Security, and support teams to make practical technical decisions, lead multi-phase improvements, and clarify ownership. You will also mentor teammates through pairing, code review, and shared operational practices. This is an individual-contributor role, not a people-management position.

 Responsibilities 

- Own endpoint reliability and lifecycle management. Improve provisioning, application delivery, updates, security configuration, and troubleshooting across the endpoint environment. 

- Make patching predictable and safe. Strengthen update workflows through testing, controlled rollouts, and remediation. 

- Make fleet health trustworthy and actionable. Improve reporting on device health, patching, and configuration, with clear ownership for resolving issues. 

- Build maintainable automation. Turn recurring work into reliable, tested workflows that other engineers can operate. 

- Advance code-managed endpoint operations. Adopt tools and practices that improve configuration management, validation, and deployment. 

- Lead cross-functional platform improvements. Define practical roadmaps, resolve dependencies, and balance security, reliability, employee experience, and team capacity. 

- Strengthen the team’s capability. Mentor teammates, review code and designs, and document reusable practices that improve coverage across the endpoint team. 

 Requirements 

- Significant experience engineering and operating Windows endpoint environments, with personal ownership beyond ticket handling or routine console administration. 

- Deep hands-on Intune experience across device lifecycle, configuration and compliance policies, application management, update workflows, and relevant Entra ID dependencies. 

- Strong Windows troubleshooting skills across operating-system behavior, services, logs, networking, certificates, identity, and security controls. Able to distinguish reported management status from actual endpoint health. 

- Recent ownership of Windows and third-party application patching, including staged deployment, user-impact validation, failed-device handling, exceptions, and recovery. 

- Strong practical PowerShell skills and familiarity with at least one additional programming language, such as Python, Go, or C#. Experience building and maintaining production automation or systems integrations. 

- Demonstrated use of version control, code review, automated checks, and controlled deployment for operational changes. Able to explain safe retries, failure handling, secrets management, and configuration drift. 

- Ability to independently define and deliver multi-phase work, prioritize under ambiguity, partner across teams, and mentor other engineers. 

- Clear written and verbal communication, including concise technical decisions, incident updates, runbooks, and effective asynchronous collaboration. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Production experience with FleetDM on Windows , including agent operations, policies, queries, targeting, API integrations, or configuration managed through GitOps. 

- Practical osquery and SQL experience for endpoint inventory, health, or security use cases, including query validation, performance considerations, and handling stale or missing results. 

- Experience with infrastructure-as-code or declarative configuration, continuous integration and delivery, and migration or coexistence between endpoint-management platforms. 

- Experience with Automox, Patch My PC, or comparable tools , and with endpoint privilege management, application control, encryption, or other security controls. 

- Experience supporting developer-heavy, distributed environments and contributing reusable automation across Windows, macOS, or Linux. 

 Durable Skills 

 AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve: 

- Awareness: U nderstand yourself and others . 

- Judgment: E valuat e information and mak e decisions in complex situations . 

- Adaptability: L earn, adjust, and stay effective through change . 

- Connection: C ommunicat e , collaborat e , and build trust . 

 To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser. 

 Compensation 
 Canada Pay Range
 $125,000 — $170,000 CAD

As a core technical contributor, you are responsible for conducting critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm’s business objectives.

- Brings discipline and creativity to solve business-critical problems, working with tech leads, product managers, and designers to bring outcomes to fruition

- Communicates with stakeholders and is comfortable leading discussions with customers

 Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills 

- Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience.

- Hands-on practical experience delivering system design, application development, testing, and operational stability

- Hands-on programming/application development experience utilizing Java, Spring Boot, REST, Microservices, RDBMS and NoSQL databases, Cloud Native, Agile, DevOps, and TDD

- Recent experience with a cloud platform such as AWS, and utilization of container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes

- Prior experience in building or using API Platforms, with deep expertise in one or more areas of the end-to-end API stack, including cloud connectivity, network diagnosis, resilient systems, API security, authentication/authorization, API gateways, and API design spanning specification, standards, documentation, and governance. 

- Advanced knowledge of software applications and technical processes, with considerable in-depth expertise in one or more technical disciplines (e.g., cloud, artificial intelligence, machine learning, mobile, etc.)

- Practical cloud native experience

- Experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field

- Demonstrated experience leading effective use of approved AI-assisted software development tools (e.g., for coding, code review, test acceleration, troubleshooting) with the ability to set team expectations for validating AI outputs for correctness, performance, and security. 

- Strong understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; experience coaching engineers on safe, compliant adoption within delivery practices

jobs.jd:
The MongoDB Product Security team is looking for a full-stack senior software engineer to help us build and scale the next generation of security practices, enabling hundreds of MongoDB engineers to build secure products for our customers.

 The Product Security team empowers product teams to build secure products for MongoDB customers by providing security enablement, such as AI-powered code analysis, threat modeling and security finding triaging and verification, fuzzing infrastructure, and finding management solutions. Our goal is to incorporate security early in product development at scale without introducing friction. With the emerging capabilities of AI models, we are proactively adopting our security practices to be prepared for the newly introduced challenges.

 This role can be based out of our Dublin or Cork office or remotely in the Ireland region. This role is expected to work with a distributed team that covers all time zones in the US.

Key Responsibilities:

 As a software engineer on our team, you will help us develop and maintain security automations, such as:

- Deliver features for an automated code analysis platform

- Expand security findings triaging and verification platform to all products across MongoDB

- Automate finding management process to be self-serve for engineering teams

- Centralized security signal analytics platform to help teams focus on the most important security work

- Design and build tooling solutions to shift security practices left in SDLC

Baseline Qualifications:

- 5+ years of experience of production-level software development with Python and TypeScript in a cloud environment

- Experience managing the end-to-end development lifecycle, including building, deploying and operating software at scale

- Experience in micro-services, Kubernetes, and containers

- Deep understanding of CI/CD systems, including linting, testing and various deployment strategies

- The ability to independently prioritize and execute tasks after alignment with the team and stakeholders

- A proven track record of identifying problems, implementing solutions and delivering complex projects 

- Strong Understanding of building AI agents

- Strong verbal and written technical communication skills

Preferred Qualifications:

- Basic knowledge of what security practices are and how they work, such as threat modeling, secure code review, and CVE

- Familiarity with C++ or Rust

- Experience designing and operating systems that execute untrusted code safely — container/sandbox isolation, least-privilege credential handling, and network egress controls.

- Experience with NoSQL or database development

About MongoDB

 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

 With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

 Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. 

 To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy , we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB , and help us make an impact on the world!

 MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

jobs.jd:
The Opportunity 
 This position where we will develop and launch a new product within Adobe working within an exciting org that is incubating next-generation ideas. Build the next generation agentic AI platform working with a research scientist, designers, and a venture lead to bring the new product to life.
 This role is an outstanding opportunity to operate like a startup founding engineer while having the resources of an innovative, large Technology company. Join us for an opportunity to invent new technologies and power a brand-new product that serves emerging creators.

 The Challenge 
 We are looking for a Founding Full Stack Engineer to build Creator Services from the ground up. Creator Services is building AI-powered audience intelligence: given a content idea and creator context, predict whether it will resonate and surface the insights that help creators make smarter decisions. As Creator Services expands into brand deal discovery, negotiation, storefront management, and affiliate programs, the research agenda grows with it.
 A core part of the platform will be agentic AI systems that automate the complex tasks creators face running their businesses. You will build and operate multi-agent pipelines. You will transform model outputs into interactive creator workflows. This will connect Creator Services to creator platforms and data sources that make the intelligence real. Collaborate closely with the Research Lead and Product & UX Lead as a peer collaborator.

 Responsibilities 
 
- Product Build (Front-to-Back): Build the mobile-first creator app and micro-studio (front-end) and the services behind it (back-end/APIs), turning research and product vision into a live product creators use daily. Stack: React / React Native or Flutter on the front-end; Python and/or Node/TypeScript on the back-end.

- Develop and manage multi-agent pipelines and prediction serving. This includes cost-efficient inference, caching, and graceful degradation when model providers falter. Also, include eval instrumentation to catch regressions in production.

- Model Productionization: Collaborate closely alongside the lead researcher to transform model outputs into responsive, low-latency creator workflows. Support deployment of trainable model components alongside base model APIs (Azure OpenAI) on Colligo (Adobe's ML platform).

- Integrations: Build integrations with external creator platforms (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok via creator-authorized OAuth), Adobe's wider suite of creative tools (Express, Firefly, Adobe Creative Suite, IMS), Semrush, and internal Adobe services.

- Data Pipelines: Build the data pipelines that feed the audience intelligence, insight, and prediction engines — including the outcome-feedback loop that lets the system learn from real creator results.

- Architecture Ownership: Own architecture decisions as an early hire — from framework choices to data models to deployment pipelines

- Observability & Reliability: Contribute to monitoring, observability, and evaluation frameworks that ensure AI-driven features behave reliably and transparently for creators.
 
 What is needed to succeed 
 
- 5+ years shipping full-stack products end-to-end (front-end + back-end + APIs) — startup or 0→1 experience strongly preferred.

- Proficiency in a modern back-end environment like Python or Node with TypeScript is required. Experience with a contemporary app/front-end stack such as React, React Native, or Flutter is also necessary. Mobile-first experience is a strong plus.

- Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs and agent frameworks; solid grasp of latency, cost, evals, and fallbacks in production — not just prototypes.

- Experience designing and building scalable APIs, backend services, and data pipelines from scratch.

- Comfort with cloud infra (Azure/AWS/GCP) and standing up services in a resource-constrained startup environment.

- Ability to move fast under ambiguity, own outcomes end-to-end, and work effectively in a small, flat team.

- A genuine interest in the creator economy and the tools creators use to build their businesses.
 
 Bonus 
 
- Experience with third-party social/platform APIs (YouTube Data API, Instagram Graph API, TikTok for Developers).

- Familiarity with the Adobe ecosystem — Firefly APIs, Adobe IMS, Creative Cloud integrations.

- Experience with recommender or ML-serving systems; Colligo or similar ML infrastructure.
 
 About Adobe 
 Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Join Mastercard’s Services Technology organization as a DevOps Principal Engineer for the Decision Management Program (DMP)—a patented, real-time decisioning platform that powers fraud prevention, risk scoring, and identity verification across the global payments network. The platform processes billions of transactions each month, consistently delivering results in milliseconds to support mission critical business solutions.

Role

In this role you will design systems to enable deployment and management of critical high-volume, low-latency financial systems into public and private cloud environments. You will work with global engineering teams to drive DevOps initiatives across the platform utilizing a highly scalable architecture leveraging In-Memory data grids and real time processing technologies. 

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of Mastercard’s decisioning ecosystem—advancing innovative, high‑performance solutions and driving engineering and operational excellence across a critical real‑time platform

• Architect, provision, and manage public and on-prem cloud infrastructure, including containerized and virtualized systems
• Design, build, and optimize CI/CD pipelines to enable fast, safe, and repeatable delivery of complex distributed systems across a global network of data centres.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D teams to design scalable systems, troubleshoot complex issues, and support new product initiatives.
• Champion Infrastructure as Code principles using tools like Terraform and CloudFormation.
• Drive observability and reliability through monitoring, logging, and alerting systems (Prometheus, Grafana, Druid, Splunk etc.).
• Foster innovation and continuous improvement, adopting new tools and practices to increase efficiency, scalability, and cost optimization.
• Contribute to hands-on coding and automation efforts when needed — lead by example.
• Partner with stakeholders to align DevOps initiatives with business objectives, including uptime, deployment velocity, and cost efficiency.

All About You

• 8+ years of experience in Software Engineering and DevOps roles, including at least 2 years in a technical leadership capacity.
• Strong Linux systems administration background
• Deep familiarity with AWS cloud environments.
• Proven experience with container orchestration and tooling (Kubernetes, Helm, Docker Compose).
• Hands-on experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
• Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, XLR etc.).
• Proficient in scripting and programming (Bash, Python, Java).
• Experience with monitoring and observability platforms (Prometheus, Grafana, Druid, Splunk, Loki).
• Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively with Developers, QE, Operations and support teams.
• Experience with FinOps or cost optimization in cloud environments
• Demonstrated ownership mindset, prioritization skills, and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, multi-tasking environment.

 Corporate Security Responsibility 
 
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
 
- Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

- Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

- Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

- Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 
 Title and Summary 

Lead Software Engineer

The Business Experimentation and Optimization (BE&O) teams within Mastercard’s Services organization are building industry-leading software that
empowers business users around the world to make data-driven decisions through advanced analytics and experimentation. As we expand our product
offerings and modernize our technology stack, we are reimagining how we deliver scalable, cloud-native solutions to our clients.

experimentation platform. 

In this role, you will help define and evolve system architecture and non-functional requirements—such as scalability, performance, security, and reliability—ensuring our solutions meet the highest engineering standards. Join us in building the future of finance.

 Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

 About the team + role 

 We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

 The International engineering team's mission is to expand Robinhood's products globally and scale our platform to support millions of new customers in diverse markets. We build and maintain experiences across onboarding, funding, account setup, localized product experiences, growth incentives, and platform capabilities to operate in new jurisdictions. Our engineering team partners closely with product, design, compliance, marketing teams, along with an array of platform engineering teams to launch new products and optimize user acquisition globally. We prioritize technical rigor, system reliability, and quick execution to deliver reliable products to our growing customer base. Our culture is centered on clear communication, strong team partnership, and a commitment to helping people manage their financial lives! 

 As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer , you will be a core technical driver for Robinhood’s global expansion initiatives. You will bridge high-performance frontend interfaces with resilient backend distributed systems, architecting and delivering localized customer experiences—from multi-currency funding and international onboarding to regional asset trading. You will design reusable, extensible platform abstractions that allow Robinhood to scale seamlessly into new international markets while upholding uncompromising standards for security, availability, and compliance. In this role, you will lead complex technical designs, raise the engineering bar across the stack, and collaborate side-by-side with product managers, designers, compliance partners, and platform teams to build financial products for our worldwide community

 This role is based in either our Toronto, Canada office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do

- Full Stack Architecture & Engineering: Develop and maintain high-quality frontend interfaces (React/TypeScript) and scale robust backend services (Go/Python) 

- Global Product Launches: Own the technical delivery of critical international capabilities, including localized onboarding funnels, identity verification (KYC/AML), multi-currency funding rails, and region-specific trading experiences

- Growth and User Acquisition: Build and optimize high-leverage growth mechanisms, localized promotion engines, and user acquisition pipelines to accelerate international market adoption.

- Reusable Internationalization Platforms: Architect modular, scalable frameworks and internationalization (i18n/l10n) services that make expanding to future jurisdictions faster, safer, and more reliable

- System Reliability & Observability: Ensure backend services and localized products are built for high availability, low latency, and fault tolerance; implement comprehensive telemetry, automated testing, and participate in production on-call rotations

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Management, Product Design, Compliance, Legal, and Platform teams to translate jurisdictional requirements into elegant, user-centric technical solutions

What you bring

- Experience: 5+ years of professional software engineering experience designing, building, and operating production systems across the full stack

- Frontend Depth: Proficiency with modern frontend technologies and frameworks (e.g., React, TypeScript) with an emphasis on performance, accessibility, and state management

- Backend & Distributed Systems: Strong experience building scalable distributed services in languages such as Go or Python, utilizing relational and NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis), and working with event-driven architectures (e.g., Kafka)

- Product Ownership: Proven track record of taking complex features from ambiguity through technical design, phased rollout, production validation, and post-launch maintenance

- API & Systems Design: Deep understanding of RESTful APIs, gRPC, service-oriented architectures, and microservice integration patterns

- Communication & Alignment: Clear, structured communication skills to articulate trade-offs, drive technical consensus across distributed teams, and align with non-technical stakeholders

 Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, and equity ownership

- Design, build, and maintain highly available, scalable, and resilient production infrastructure across cloud environments. 

- Drive system-wide automated alerting and monitoring strategies for infrastructure and database environments.

Collaborate with DevOps, Engineering, Product, Security, and Operations teams to scale and secure our cloud-native platform.
