jobs.title: Principal AI Engineer - Context - Agents and Context
jobs.jd:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

 What is The Role 

 The Context Engine team builds the knowledge layer that AI agents use to work with enterprise data in Elasticsearch. We extract knowledge from any data sources into a structured AI Index, serve it to agents through public APIs, MCP tools and framework integrations, and close the loop with agent traces so that what the engine knows improves from real usage. Any agent can use it: Elastic’s own Agent Builder, Claude Code, LangChain and other third-party harnesses.

 As a Principal AI Engineer, you own the improvement loop of this product end to end: how agents, automations and skills behave in production, how we observe them, how we evaluate them, and how we ship changes to them safely. This is a hybrid role at the intersection of engineering, data science, and product. You will write production code, design evaluation and telemetry that product decisions can rest on, and set the technical bar for how the team iterates on agentic behaviour. You will work alongside data scientists, backend engineers, product, and UX, and your work will show up directly in what customers build on top of Elastic.

 The codebase is TypeScript and we build it in the open, so you'll be shipping code, designs and discussions in public alongside the rest of the Elastic Stack.

 What You Will Be Doing 

- Own the production improvement loop for Context Engine: understand how extraction automations, retrieval tools and memory behave, based on offline evaluations and customer conversations and telemetry. You help find the failure modes, fix them, and prove the fix.

- Define how we iterate on agents and skills safely: versioning and rollout of prompts, skills and automations, regression coverage, staged and shadow evaluation, and the guardrails that let us change behaviour without breaking customers.

- Design the telemetry we need to make data-informed engineering decisions: what to capture from agent traces, tool calls and knowledge retrieval, how it lands in Elasticsearch, and how it feeds evaluation, dashboards and the feedback loop.

- Partner with the data science team on evaluation strategy: golden datasets, evaluators to gate on quality, latency and cost.

- Raise the bar across the team: review designs and PRs, mentor engineers in eval-driven development, and write the technical proposals that shape the roadmap.

What You Bring

- 10+ years of software engineering experience, with the recent years spent shipping and operating AI-driven products on real production traffic, ideally products with public APIs and data models that had to evolve without breaking customers.

- A track record of eval-driven product improvement: you have diagnosed agent or LLM behaviour from traces and user feedback, designed the evaluation that exposed the problem, shipped the fix and measured the outcome.

- Direct experience building agents with state and memory, and iterating on prompts, skills and tool behaviour safely in production.

- Familiarity with MCP, including exposing public MCP servers and tools.

- Experience designing telemetry for AI systems, and using it to make engineering and product decisions.

- Experience running product experiments end to end: instrumentation, unattended execution, and interpreting results.

- Experience building products with public APIs and evolving data models, and the judgement that comes with maintaining external contracts as a product changes.

- Strong backend engineering skills in either Python or TypeScript: APIs, stateful workflows, data pipelines and production services.

- Comfort working with data scientists, engineers, and product managers as peers, translating between measurement and shipping, and communicating trade-offs clearly.

- A pragmatic, low-ego style suited to a distributed, async-first team.

Bonus Points

- Experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, Claude Agent SDK, or similar.

- Agentic retrieval experience, including knowledge representation.

- Practical Elasticsearch experience.

 Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component. 

 At Elastic, our compensation philosophy aims to provide fair, competitive and transparent remuneration. Salary ranges are established based on a combination of external market benchmarks, internal pay equity considerations, and the responsibilities and complexity associated with each role. This approach helps ensure consistency across comparable roles while remaining competitive within the relevant labour markets.

 The final compensation offered within the applicable range will be determined based on several objective factors, including relevant professional experience, level of skills and expertise, alignment with the role requirements, and the overall scope and complexity of the position.

jobs.jd:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

 What is The Role 

 The Context Engine team builds the knowledge layer that AI agents use to work with enterprise data in Elasticsearch. We extract knowledge from any data sources into a structured AI Index, serve it to agents through public APIs, MCP tools and framework integrations, and close the loop with agent traces so that what the engine knows improves from real usage. Any agent can use it: Elastic’s own Agent Builder, Claude Code, LangChain and other third-party harnesses.

 As a Principal AI Engineer, you own the improvement loop of this product end to end: how agents, automations and skills behave in production, how we observe them, how we evaluate them, and how we ship changes to them safely. This is a hybrid role at the intersection of engineering, data science, and product. You will write production code, design evaluation and telemetry that product decisions can rest on, and set the technical bar for how the team iterates on agentic behaviour. You will work alongside data scientists, backend engineers, product, and UX, and your work will show up directly in what customers build on top of Elastic.

 The codebase is TypeScript and we build it in the open, so you'll be shipping code, designs and discussions in public alongside the rest of the Elastic Stack.

 What You Will Be Doing 

- Own the production improvement loop for Context Engine: understand how extraction automations, retrieval tools and memory behave, based on offline evaluations and customer conversations and telemetry. You help find the failure modes, fix them, and prove the fix.

- Define how we iterate on agents and skills safely: versioning and rollout of prompts, skills and automations, regression coverage, staged and shadow evaluation, and the guardrails that let us change behaviour without breaking customers.

- Design the telemetry we need to make data-informed engineering decisions: what to capture from agent traces, tool calls and knowledge retrieval, how it lands in Elasticsearch, and how it feeds evaluation, dashboards and the feedback loop.

- Partner with the data science team on evaluation strategy: golden datasets, evaluators to gate on quality, latency and cost.

- Raise the bar across the team: review designs and PRs, mentor engineers in eval-driven development, and write the technical proposals that shape the roadmap.

What You Bring

- 10+ years of software engineering experience, with the recent years spent shipping and operating AI-driven products on real production traffic, ideally products with public APIs and data models that had to evolve without breaking customers.

- A track record of eval-driven product improvement: you have diagnosed agent or LLM behaviour from traces and user feedback, designed the evaluation that exposed the problem, shipped the fix and measured the outcome.

- Direct experience building agents with state and memory, and iterating on prompts, skills and tool behaviour safely in production.

- Familiarity with MCP, including exposing public MCP servers and tools.

- Experience designing telemetry for AI systems, and using it to make engineering and product decisions.

- Experience running product experiments end to end: instrumentation, unattended execution, and interpreting results.

- Experience building products with public APIs and evolving data models, and the judgement that comes with maintaining external contracts as a product changes.

- Strong backend engineering skills in either Python or TypeScript: APIs, stateful workflows, data pipelines and production services.

- Comfort working with data scientists, engineers, and product managers as peers, translating between measurement and shipping, and communicating trade-offs clearly.

- A pragmatic, low-ego style suited to a distributed, async-first team.

Bonus Points

- Experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, Claude Agent SDK, or similar.

- Agentic retrieval experience, including knowledge representation.

- Practical Elasticsearch experience.

 Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component. 

 At Elastic, our compensation philosophy aims to provide fair, competitive and transparent remuneration. Salary ranges are established based on a combination of external market benchmarks, internal pay equity considerations, and the responsibilities and complexity associated with each role. This approach helps ensure consistency across comparable roles while remaining competitive within the relevant labour markets.

 The final compensation offered within the applicable range will be determined based on several objective factors, including relevant professional experience, level of skills and expertise, alignment with the role requirements, and the overall scope and complexity of the position.

 The typical starting salary range for this role is:
 €104.800 — €165.700 EUR 

 Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People 

 As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Integrations 3P - Platform
jobs.jd:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

 What is The Role 

 We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Integrations Team and help us build how Elastic shows up inside the AI ecosystem. AI assistants and agentic tools are quickly becoming the place where developers start their work, and this role exists to make Elastic work in the tools and ecosystems that our users use. We want to be easy to find, easy to connect to, and easy to use.

 The Integrations team owns the developer-facing surfaces that connect Elastic to the broader ecosystem: language clients, CLI, MCP server, third-party integrations, and the skills that make Elastic accessible wherever developers work. You'll build and maintain these projects, engage directly with the developer community, and contribute across team and cross-functional initiatives.

 This is fast-moving territory. We want someone who enjoys an ambiguous, quick-shifting space, who forms opinions about what should be built and not only how, and who is comfortable working closely with our product teams and external partners.

 Prior experience with the Elastic product suite is not essential, but is beneficial.

 What You Will Be Doing 

- You'll build and evolve the Elastic MCP server and the infrastructure behind it, working primarily in Go.

- You'll build the platform for universal agent skills: the portable format, the authoring and publishing tooling, and the linting that lets any team at Elastic ship a skill that runs across every agent.

- You'll help set the correctness bar, making sure the skills and tools we ship are backed by evals rather than assumed to work.

- You'll design and deliver integrations that make Elastic available inside third-party AI ecosystems. For that you’ll work closely with our product team and third-party partners to shape and land those integrations.

- You'll contribute to our Elastic CLI to enhance the efficiency of developers and their agents.

- You'll be developing, maintaining, and supporting libraries, tools, and integrations related to the Elastic Stack, working in a mixture of languages including Go and Rust.

- You'll bring product thinking to the team, holding and defending opinions on what we should build and why, informed by the ecosystem around us.

What You Bring

- 8+ years of software engineering experience working on backend systems, services or libraries.

- Proficiency with AI/ML frameworks and a working understanding of LLMs, agents, agent skills and protocols such as MCP. Interest in proving correctness through evaluation rather than assuming it.

- Significant recent working experience of Go and (ideally) other languages.

- Knowledge of client-server networking, HTTP, and RESTful APIs.

- Comfort reading and contributing to codebases in languages you don't own, and no fear of picking up an unfamiliar one.

- Knowledge of industry best practices in software engineering.

- Product thinking: an interest in the wider ecosystem and strong opinions on what is worth building.

- A strong focus on usability and developer experience.

- Comfort with context-switching and with a space that changes quickly.

- A genuine interest in technology and an active interest in exploring multiple programming languages.

- Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills, including in front of customers and external partners.

- A willingness to work as part of a remote, globally distributed team.

- Clear thinking, self-motivation, and the ability to learn and work independently.

Bonus Points

- Experience building or operating infrastructure, and an interest in telemetry and observability (nice to have)

- A connection to technical communities through open source projects, blogs or talks (nice to have)

- Experience working with third-party or partner engineering teams (nice to have)

- Prior experience of Elastic products (nice to have)

 Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component.

jobs.jd:
Job Description:
 
 About This Opportunity 
 This is a pipeline requisition supporting multiple Software Engineer opportunities across Fidelity's Galway technology organisation. We anticipate hiring for up to multiple positions across a range of engineering teams.
 
 Successful candidates may be considered for different opportunities based on their experience, technical skills, interests, and current business priorities. Throughout the process, our Talent Acquisition team will work with candidates to identify the role that best aligns with their background, career aspirations, and team needs.
 
 Team assignments may include areas such as Contact Centre Technology, Asset Management Technology, Workplace Investing and other enterprise engineering teams.
 
 This approach allows candidates to be considered for multiple engineering opportunities through a single application process.
 
 The Role 
 Are you passionate about building innovative technology solutions that solve complex business challenges and deliver exceptional customer experiences? We are seeking Software Engineers to join one of our dynamic technology teams, where you will contribute to the design, development, and delivery of scalable enterprise applications.
 
 Working in a collaborative agile environment, you will partner with engineers, architects, and product teams to build high-quality software solutions, enhance existing platforms, and help drive engineering excellence across our technology organisation. This is an exciting opportunity to work on modern technologies while continuing to grow your technical and professional skills.
 
 The Experience and Skills You Bring

- 3+ years of professional software development experience.

- Proficiency in Java and experience working with modern application frameworks such as Spring or Spring Boot.

- Experience developing RESTful APIs and distributed applications.

- Knowledge of software design principles, data structures, and object-oriented programming.

- Experience working with relational and/or NoSQL databases.

- Understanding of event-driven, service-oriented, or microservices-based architectures.

- Exposure to modern front-end technologies such as React, Angular, or similar frameworks.

- Experience with automated testing practices and frameworks.

Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.



We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.



Here’s what this particular role covers.



🛠️ About our AI Platform Team

Our AI Platform teams build the foundations that enable Wayve’s machine learning engineers and researchers to train, evaluate and deploy models at scale. Within the AI Libraries team, you’ll create high-quality platforms, tools and reusable abstractions that support thousands of GPUs and help accelerate the development of our autonomous-driving technology.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

You’ll work closely with machine learning teams to understand their workflows and turn complex requirements into stable, scalable and intuitive software. You’ll spend much of your time designing and writing Python, leading projects from discovery through delivery, improving engineering standards and supporting users as they push the scale and performance of their models.



🧩 What you’ll be working on

You’ll build modular libraries for areas such as multimodal data loading, distributed training and inference, checkpointing and observability. You’ll improve the reliability, performance and developer experience of systems used across Wayve, helping teams train models efficiently on large GPU clusters and work with camera, radar, lidar and other data sources.

 

🙌 You should apply if

You have deep Python expertise and a proven track record of leading the design, delivery and long-term evolution of high-quality software systems at scale. You can turn complex requirements across ML teams into stable, reusable libraries and clear APIs, set technical direction, and raise the bar for software architecture, testing and observability. You remain hands-on while guiding other engineers and driving projects end to end, from shaping requirements through to adoption and maintenance. Experience with concurrent, parallel or distributed computing is important; familiarity with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow and cloud environments—ideally Azure—is highly valuable. This is a Staff-level software and platform engineering role, not an ML modelling position.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. jobs.jd:
MEET BENEVITY

Benevity is the way the world does good, providing companies (and their employees) with technology to take social action on the issues they care about. Through giving, volunteering, grantmaking, employee resource groups and micro-actions, we help most of the Fortune 100 brands build better cultures and use their power for good. We’re also one of the first B Corporations in Canada, meaning we’re as committed to purpose as we are to profits. We have people working all over the world, including Canada, Spain, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, the United States and more!



High Level Role Overview

 

As a DevEX Senior Staff Developer at Benevity, you will lead Developer Experience and SDLC modernization across our technology organization. Sitting at the intersection of hands-on platform engineering, process evolution, and technical leadership, you will design the tooling and infrastructure that transforms AI-assisted development into a seamless, company-wide operating model. Reporting to the Director of Engineering, you will collaborate closely with Principal Architects, Staff Developers, Security, and product teams to remove friction, implement agentic automation, and build inclusive foundations that empower all of our teams to deliver high-quality software safely and sustainably.

 

What you’ll do:

 - Lead DevX and SDLC technical direction across domains, enabling AI-DLC and agentic automation

 - Design and scale agentic systems that accelerate the full software development lifecycle

 - Make AI a natural extension of engineering practice while keeping human judgment and security in the loop

 - Drive reusable and extendable architecture for developer platforms using public cloud infrastructure

 - Work collaboratively with Principal Architects to guide our organizational DevX and AI-DLC strategy

 - Partner with stakeholders to translate business needs into highly adoptable platform solutions

 - Solve cross-cutting challenges like dev environments, CI/CD supply chains, authentication, and quality gates

 - Treat adoption as a primary outcome by diagnosing friction and influencing without authority

 - Turn promising tools and shared components into widely used organizational standards

 - Ensure DevSecOps practices and cloud-native security are built securely into the delivery stack

 - Create and maintain clear technical documentation, enablement guides, and implementation processes

 - Promote the adoption of industry-standard tools and shared platform capabilities across the organization

 - Ideate and implement thoughtful proof of concepts for platform, agentic, and product advancement

 - Provide supportive mentorship to senior developers through practical examples and constructive feedback

 - Actively participate in architectural reviews to ensure inclusive design, quality, and consistency

What you’ll bring:

 - Proven hands-on experience in Developer Experience (DevX), including building internal developer platforms (IDPs), golden-path templates, automated quality gates, and shared engineering component libraries

 - 8+ years of scalable software development experience with software design accountability

 - 2+ years in a technical leadership role driving org-wide platform capabilities or engineering productivity

 - Expertise in scaling Developer Experience, SDLC tooling, or modern engineering productivity systems

 - Hands-on background with AI-assisted development, agentic workflows, and LLM tooling

 - Deep commitment to secure, ethical delivery practices and fostering an inclusive engineering culture

 - Strong grasp of core cloud infrastructure and how to scale technical solutions across multiple teams

 - Demonstrated ability to diagnose team friction, influence workflows, and thoughtfully drive tool adoption

 - Solid understanding of API-first design, loosely coupled systems, and modern software architecture

 - Proficiency with Infrastructure-as-Code, DevSecOps practices, and modern CI/CD pipelines

 - Experience coding in Python and/or Java along with familiar frameworks like FastAPI or Spring Boot

 - Familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure on AWS or GCP, with Azure experience as a great bonus

 - Excellent communication skills to align product, architecture, security, and engineering teams

 - Comfort navigating ambiguous problems with a strong bias toward shipping measurable, user-friendly improvements

 - Background integrating engineering systems like Jira, CI, and observability into cohesive workflows


DISCOVER YOUR PURPOSE AT WORK

We’re not employees, we’re Benevity-ites. From all locations, backgrounds and walks of life, who deserve more …

Innovative work. Growth opportunities. Caring co-workers. And a chance to do work that fills us with a sense of purpose.

If the idea of working on tech that helps people do good in the world lights you up ... If you want a career where you’re valued for who you are and challenged to see who you can become …

It’s time to join Benevity. We’re so excited to meet you.



WHERE WE WORK

At Benevity, we embrace a flexible hybrid approach to where we work that empowers our people in a way that supports great work, strong relationships, and personal well-being. For those located near one of our offices, while there’s no set requirement for in-office time, we do value the moments when coming together in person helps us build connection and collaboration. Whether it’s for onboarding, project work, or a chance to align and bond as a team, we trust our people to make thoughtful decisions about when showing up in person matters most.

Diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging are part of Benevity’s DNA. You’ll see the impact of our massive investment in DEIB daily — from our well-supported employee resources groups to the exceptional diversity on our leadership and tech teams.

jobs.jd:
Why join us 

 Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

 Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

 Engineering at Brex 

 Engineering at Brex is about building systems that scale with speed and intention. Our teams span Software, Data, Security, and IT, and operate with high autonomy and deep collaboration. We tackle hard technical problems, own our outcomes, and push for excellence at every level — from architecture to deployment. It’s an environment where engineering is a craft, and builders become leaders.

 About the team 

 Acquisition Engineering owns the customer journey from first touch to first value: helping prospective customers discover Brex, apply, get approved, onboard quickly, and adopt more of the platform over time. The group brings together GTM Engineering, Salesforce, Onboarding, and Adoption, with a shared mission to acquire customers faster and deliver value sooner.

 We operate at the intersection of customer experience, revenue, and operational scale. Our work improves funnel conversion, reduces time to first transaction, equips go-to-market teams with high-leverage systems, and creates product experiences that drive durable adoption and expansion.

 What you’ll do 

 We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to operate across Acquisition Engineering. You won’t be limited to a single team or service; your mandate is to identify the highest-impact technical opportunities across the funnel—especially the cross-team gaps that no individual team can solve alone—and drive them to durable outcomes.

 This is a leadership role without direct reports. You’ll set technical direction, raise the bar for system design and execution, and multiply the effectiveness of engineers and engineering managers across the group. You’ll partner closely with Staff Engineers, product leaders, and GTM stakeholders to shape where we invest and how we deliver customer and business impact.

 Where you’ll work 

 This role will be based in San Francisco . We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We require three days per week in the office—Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday—and offer up to four weeks per year of fully remote work.

 Responsibilities: 

- Identify and lead the most consequential technical initiatives across Acquisition Engineering, from first touch through onboarding, activation, and ongoing adoption.

- Set technical direction for cross-team systems, including architecture, platform boundaries, reliability, and data quality.

- Partner with GTM Engineering, Salesforce, Onboarding, and Adoption to simplify handoffs and improve end-to-end customer and operator experiences.

- Raise the technical bar through design reviews, hands-on implementation, operational excellence, and pragmatic engineering standards.

- Champion repeatable, secure, and high-velocity delivery across the group, including strong practices for code review, deployment safety, and operational excellence.

- Act as a force multiplier by mentoring senior engineers, improving how teams plan and execute, and developing the next generation of technical leaders.

- Collaborate with product, design, data, operations, and go-to-market partners to translate ambiguous business opportunities into scalable technical solutions.

- Bring an AI-forward mindset to how the group builds customer experiences, internal tooling, and engineering workflows.

 Requirements: 

- 8+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of technical leadership across multiple teams or a large product area.

- Demonstrated ability to identify and drive ambiguous, cross-cutting problems to resolution without a narrowly defined charter.

- Deep experience designing, building, and operating large-scale backend or full-stack systems in production.

- Strong product and business judgment, with the ability to connect technical investments to customer experience, growth, and operational outcomes.

- Proven ability to influence across engineering, product, and business stakeholders without direct authority.

- Strong collaboration, written, and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical trade-offs to senior business and engineering stakeholders.

 Compensation: 

 The expected salary range for this role is $240,000 - $300,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

 Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.
 Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer, Agentic Systems
jobs.location: Palo Alto, CA | Palo Alto, CA, United States
jobs.jd:
About the team: 

 Rubrik secures and accelerates the world’s AI transformation. As AI agents reshape the enterprise, Rubrik’s Enterprise AI Incubation team proves it on Rubrik itself.
We are building a thinking enterprise: applications that don't just record the business but help run it. They learn from our data, act through our own agents, and improve with every decision. 
Fully backed by executive leadership, this team drives meaningful, large-scale enterprise transformation.

About the role:

 We want senior engineers who have already shipped agents that real people rely on, and who are ready to do it again at higher stakes. You will drop into the real work, redesign it around agents that carry it end to end, and ship it as the new way that part of Rubrik operates.You’ll own your agent systems end to end: understanding the workflow, designing the architecture, writing the code, deploying, and running it in production. Rather than simply querying an API, you engineer robust, production-grade infrastructure around model endpoints, integrating custom tooling, context pipelines, automated evaluations, and defensive guardrails to ensure resilience against unstructured real-world data.

 You also decide whether a problem needs an agent, a simpler automation, or nothing at all, and you have explicit authority to stop or re-scope work that won’t deliver impact. You thrive in ambiguous environments with a low-ego mindset, leveraging AI coding tools as core collaborative partners in your engineering workflow.

What you’ll do:

- Lead product discovery alongside Product Managers and domain experts to understand real workflows, map them out, and define clear problems, baselines, and success criteria as the foundation for building agentic solutions.

- Design, build, test, and deploy production agents, automations, and internal tools using coding agents, LLM APIs, and agent frameworks, integrated with Rubrik’s internal agent platform and business systems.

- Turn complex processes into multi-agent workflows that carry real work and make decisions: orchestrators that qualify and routes deals, workers that move orders through approval and fulfillment under business rules, agents that monitor signals and recommend actions for customer health, or coordinated agents that handle hire-to-retire steps across HR, IT, and managers with shared state and clear handoffs.

- Engineer agents for autonomy with reliability, including tool and orchestration flows, context management, caching, retries, and failure handling.

- Leverage full-stack engineering across backend services, APIs, data models, interactive screens, approval UIs, and chat interfaces as the complete medium to deliver high-ownership, user-facing agent systems.

- Apply solid software engineering practices to AI systems, treating prompts, skills, configs, and specs as versioned artifacts, with code review, tests, CI or CD, and staged rollouts.

- Implement evaluation, guardrails, and quality control: derive evals from workflow data, establish quality gates and guardrails, integrate human-in-the-loop approvals where needed, and monitor production runs to refine agents over time.

- Use measured results to decide how to evolve or retire agents, and turn successful systems into patterns and libraries that can be reused.

Experience you’ll need:

- Around 7 or more years of professional software engineering experience in production systems, and around 2 or more years of professional, hands-on experience building AI agents and agent powered production applications with measurable outcomes.

- Strong full stack engineering background, with a track record of designing, building, and owning services end to end, including backend APIs and integrations, data models, and user facing interfaces such as approval UIs, dashboards, or chat surfaces.

- A builder mindset: comfortable defining baselines and metrics, reporting results in business terms, working in a fast moving environment, and closing the loop by building, demoing, learning, and building again. If you like seeing improvements in hours saved, errors avoided, and teams unblocked, you will have plenty of chances to measure that here.

Software engineering skills and best practices:

- System design: break down complex problems, design APIs and data models, reason about latency, throughput, and failure modes, and choose simple, robust architectures.

- Algorithms, data structures, access control permissions, and data provenance.

- Spec driven development: turn vague requirements into clear problem statements, write or refine design docs, and use a Spec → Plan → Task → Code→ Converge flow so work is traceable from design to code, including when you use AI coding agents.

- Execution discipline: use version control, code review, automated tests, CI or CD, staged rollouts and rollbacks, logging, metrics, and tracing, and improve systems based on issues and signals from production.

AI engineering skills and best practices:

- Build agents in code using LLM APIs, SDKs, and libraries, not just no code or low code tools, and have shipped agentic systems that real users rely on.

- Design robust agent harnesses and multi agent orchestrations: model tools and resources, manage context and state, and keep runs reliable under real world data and load.

- Establish continuous evaluation and safety mechanisms: turn production failures into test cases, gate changes on eval suite results, and enforce guardrails across agent workflows.

- Exercise clear judgment on AI fit: decide when a problem needs an agent versus a simpler automation or no build, and make tradeoffs around model choice, latency and cost, context strategy, and autonomy using data rather than intuition.

Preferred qualifications:

- Knowledge/context graphs: entities and relationships, GraphRAG, hybrid retrieval.

- Agent frameworks and runtimes: Google ADK, LangGraph, OpenAI style, cloud or container platforms.

- Backend: Python, FastAPI or simi

jobs.title: Salesforce Technical Architect (Salesforce experience is Mandatory)
jobs.jd:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. 
 
 Job Category 
Customer Success 
 Job Details 
 
 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
 
 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Job Description 
 Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.

You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background. 

 What You'll Actually Be Doing 
 
- Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations 

- Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce 

- Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits 

- Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases 

- Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI-First Delivery & Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation 

- Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance 

- Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations 

- Focus on Performance Evaluation & ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases 

- Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role 

- Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly 

- From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly 

- Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations 

- Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75% 

 You're Our Person If... 
 
- Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.) 

- 9-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform 

- Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds, as well as an understanding of Agentforce architecture 

- Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits 

- Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks 

- Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture 

- Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely 

- Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas 

- Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies 

- Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL) 

- Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality

Role Overview
 Citi's Equities Technology organization is seeking a Senior Software Engineer – Ultra Low Latency Risk Engine Lead Developer to join the Equities Electronic Execution (Electronic Trading) technology team. This role is focused on the design, development, and delivery of Citi's next-generation low-latency Risk Engine for cash equities and its integration into the broader execution platform — encompassing the Centralised Position Service, Client Connectivity, Market Access layers, and high-throughput market data processing.
 The engineer will own critical, latency-sensitive risk-checking components that sit directly in the cash equities trading hot path, ensuring pre-trade and real-time risk controls are enforced with microsecond-level performance while maintaining correctness and resiliency at scale. This is a hands-on, deeply technical role that also carries leadership responsibilities — mentoring engineers, driving architecture decisions, and coordinating delivery across global development centers.
 The person will collaborate closely with product development, quantitative research, technology infrastructure, production support, and QA teams, with close alignment to global strategy and cross-regional delivery (APAC, EMEA, NAM).

Responsibilities

 Risk Engine & Core Development 
 
- Design, develop, and maintain the ultra low-latency, in-line Risk Engine responsible for real-time pre-trade risk checks, position limits, and exposure controls across cash equities electronic execution flows.
 
- Architect and optimize high-performance, lock-minimal, multi-threaded components capable of processing risk decisions in the sub-microsecond to low-microsecond range.
 
- Integrate risk and position components with Client Connectivity, Market Access layers, and high-throughput market data feed handlers.
 
- Apply deep expertise in JVM performance tuning, memory management, garbage collection avoidance, and/or native (C++/Rust) performance engineering to eliminate latency outliers ("jitter") in the risk path.
 
- Perform system-level performance tuning to minimize end-to-end latency and jitter across the risk and execution path.

Qualifications
 
- 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on experience building risk management, position-keeping, or other latency-critical systems for cash equities electronic trading or algorithmic trading platforms at a global investment bank or equivalent financial institution.
 
- Strong, hands-on technical expertise in Low Latency Java and/or C++ (Rust a plus), including multi-threading, concurrency, lock-free data structures, Java NIO, and JVM/GC performance tuning.
 
- Hands-on experience with low-latency messaging and IPC frameworks such as Aeron, Solace, or equivalent shared-memory/IPC technologies for building distributed, high-throughput trading systems.
 
- Demonstrated background in real-time distributed risk management systems for cash equities flow products , including asynchronous, event-driven architectures.
 
- Practical, hands-on experience with NUMA-aware design, CPU core pinning/affinity and isolation, Linux kernel/OS tuning, and low-latency networking (kernel bypass, RDMA, or specialized NIC tuning) for ultra low-latency, high-throughput systems.
 
- Strong understanding of automated testing techniques, test-driven development, and quality engineering practices for mission-critical systems.
 
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present and grasp complex technical and risk concepts in a multicultural, cross-regional environment, and to work effectively with globally distributed stakeholders (trading desks, quants, infrastructure, and support teams).
 
- Working knowledge of regional exchange microstructure and relevant regulatory regimes governing cash equities electronic trading and risk controls.

Education

jobs.location: Seattle, WA | San Francisco, California, United States
jobs.jd:
About Anthropic 

 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

 About the Role 

 Anthropic manages one of the largest and fastest-growing infrastructure fleets in the industry — spanning multiple accelerator families, cpu families and clouds. The Capacity Engineering team is responsible for making sure all our infrastructure resources are accounted for, well-utilized, and efficiently allocated. We own the data, tooling, and operational systems that let Anthropic plan, measure, and maximize utilization across first-party and third-party compute.

 As an engineer on Capacity Engineering, you will build the production systems that power this work: data pipelines that ingest and normalize telemetry from heterogeneous cloud environments, observability tooling that gives the org real-time visibility into fleet health, and performance instrumentation that measures how efficiently every major workload uses the hardware it’s running on. You will be expected to write production-quality code every day, operate alongside Kubernetes-native infrastructure at meaningful scale, and directly influence decisions around one of Anthropic’s largest areas of spend.

 You’ll collaborate closely with research engineering, infrastructure, inference, and finance teams. The work requires someone who can move between data engineering, systems engineering, and observability with comfort — and who thrives in a high-autonomy, high-ambiguity environment.

 This is a pipeline role feeding four areas. Depending on your background and business priority, you’ll focus primarily in one, but the boundaries are fluid and the problems overlap: 

- Data platform Pipelines that ingest occupancy and utilization telemetry from Kubernetes clusters, normalize billing and usage across cloud providers, and serve the BigQuery tables the rest of the org queries against. Correctness, completeness, and latency are the job, not a footnote. Consumers range from research engineers to finance to leadership, so it's product work as much as engineering: defining schema contracts, making data discoverable, and figuring out what people actually need.

- Planning Knowing what the fleet has, where it's going, and what's in the way. Making the state of the fleet legible and actionable in real time: cluster health tooling, capacity planning platforms, alerting on occupancy drops and allocation problems, and systemic fixes to scheduling and fragmentation. Kubernetes operations on one side, cross-team coordination on the other.

- Efficiency Measuring and improving how effectively every major workload uses the hardware it runs on. Instrumenting utilization across training, inference, and eval systems, building benchmarking infrastructure, establishing per-config baselines, and working directly with system-owning teams to close the gaps. The metric has to be good enough that the team on the hook for it agrees with the number.

- Attribution and forecasting Connecting what the fleet costs to what the business is doing with it. Reconciling CSP billing exports against vendor telemetry and internal systems with mismatched schemas, attributing spend to the workloads and teams that generate it, and turning inference demand signals and research roadmaps into a defensible compute plan. Efficiency metrics have to survive contact with finance: stripped of pure demand and unit-price effects, reproducible month over month, and legible to a CFO.

 Key responsibilities 

- Build the planning and allocation stack — the tools leadership uses to allocate capacity, teams use to plan against their allocations, and the scheduler enforces. Cross-region and cross-provider placement, guardrails, queueing, occupancy KPIs.

- Drive the efficiency programs: stranding and rightsizing, unused capacity recovery, and job-level utilization across training, inference, and eval. Establish per-config baselines and work with system-owning teams to close the gaps. Utilization improvements are worth enormous sums at our scale.

- Own attribution and forecasting — reconcile billing across ten-plus providers against telemetry and internal systems, attribute spend to the workloads that generate it, and turn demand signals and research roadmaps into a defensible compute plan and supply pipeline.

- Build the data platform underneath all of it: pipelines ingesting occupancy, utilization, and cost from a rapidly diversifying fleet into BigQuery, with real ownership of completeness, latency SLOs, and gap detection. Every new provider is a net-new integration.

- Operate Kubernetes-native systems at scale — collection agents, workload labeling, and the taint/reservation/scheduling behavior that determines what capacity is actually usable.

- Treat the output as a product, not a pipeline. Gather your own requirements, define schema contracts, and design for consumers ranging from research engineers to a CFO — including on-call and SLOs, because these surfaces are load-bearing for the company.

 What you bring 

- A strong track record building and operating production systems. This is a hands-on engineering role with a devops flavor.

- Python and SQL at production quality. Most pipeline code is Python; the presentation layer is BigQuery SQL, including table-valued functions and views. Both need to be idiomatic, well-tested, and maintainable.

- Deep experience with at least one major cloud provider (Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure) and its operations

- Experience with observability tooling stack, including Prometheus, PromQL, and Grafana, including writing recording rules and building monitoring that engineering teams rely on.

- Ability to gather your own requirements and work across organizational b

jobs.title: Principal AI Engineer - Context - Agents and Context
jobs.jd:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

 What is The Role 

 The Context Engine team builds the knowledge layer that AI agents use to work with enterprise data in Elasticsearch. We extract knowledge from any data sources into a structured AI Index, serve it to agents through public APIs, MCP tools and framework integrations, and close the loop with agent traces so that what the engine knows improves from real usage. Any agent can use it: Elastic’s own Agent Builder, Claude Code, LangChain and other third-party harnesses.

 As a Principal AI Engineer, you own the improvement loop of this product end to end: how agents, automations and skills behave in production, how we observe them, how we evaluate them, and how we ship changes to them safely. This is a hybrid role at the intersection of engineering, data science, and product. You will write production code, design evaluation and telemetry that product decisions can rest on, and set the technical bar for how the team iterates on agentic behaviour. You will work alongside data scientists, backend engineers, product, and UX, and your work will show up directly in what customers build on top of Elastic.

 The codebase is TypeScript and we build it in the open, so you'll be shipping code, designs and discussions in public alongside the rest of the Elastic Stack.

 What You Will Be Doing 

- Own the production improvement loop for Context Engine: understand how extraction automations, retrieval tools and memory behave, based on offline evaluations and customer conversations and telemetry. You help find the failure modes, fix them, and prove the fix.

- Define how we iterate on agents and skills safely: versioning and rollout of prompts, skills and automations, regression coverage, staged and shadow evaluation, and the guardrails that let us change behaviour without breaking customers.

- Design the telemetry we need to make data-informed engineering decisions: what to capture from agent traces, tool calls and knowledge retrieval, how it lands in Elasticsearch, and how it feeds evaluation, dashboards and the feedback loop.

- Partner with the data science team on evaluation strategy: golden datasets, evaluators to gate on quality, latency and cost.

- Raise the bar across the team: review designs and PRs, mentor engineers in eval-driven development, and write the technical proposals that shape the roadmap.

What You Bring

- 10+ years of software engineering experience, with the recent years spent shipping and operating AI-driven products on real production traffic, ideally products with public APIs and data models that had to evolve without breaking customers.

- A track record of eval-driven product improvement: you have diagnosed agent or LLM behaviour from traces and user feedback, designed the evaluation that exposed the problem, shipped the fix and measured the outcome.

- Direct experience building agents with state and memory, and iterating on prompts, skills and tool behaviour safely in production.

- Familiarity with MCP, including exposing public MCP servers and tools.

- Experience designing telemetry for AI systems, and using it to make engineering and product decisions.

- Experience running product experiments end to end: instrumentation, unattended execution, and interpreting results.

- Experience building products with public APIs and evolving data models, and the judgement that comes with maintaining external contracts as a product changes.

- Strong backend engineering skills in either Python or TypeScript: APIs, stateful workflows, data pipelines and production services.

- Comfort working with data scientists, engineers, and product managers as peers, translating between measurement and shipping, and communicating trade-offs clearly.

- A pragmatic, low-ego style suited to a distributed, async-first team.

Bonus Points

- Experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, Claude Agent SDK, or similar.

- Agentic retrieval experience, including knowledge representation.

- Practical Elasticsearch experience.

 Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component. The typical starting salary range for new hires in this role is listed below. 

 These ranges represent the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the ranges may be modified in the future. 

 An employee's position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

 Elastic believes that employees should have the opportunity to share in the value that we create together for our shareholders. Therefore, in addition to cash compensation, this role is currently eligible to participate in Elastic's stock program. Our total rewards package also includes a company-matched Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) with dollar-for-dollar matching up to 6% of eligible earnings, along with a range of other benefits offered with a holistic emphasis on employee well-being.

 The typical starting salary range for this role is:
 $154,000 — $243,600 CAD 

 Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Performance Tuning - Elasticsearch
jobs.jd:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

 What is The Role 

 Elasticsearch powers search, observability, and AI retrieval (RAG) for the world's largest organizations. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join the Elasticsearch Performance team. In this role, you will contribute to performance engineering initiatives through high-quality code and technical analysis. Your goal is to help improve the optimization and predictability of Elasticsearch performance, collaborating with area-specific teams to enhance our software.

 What You Will Be Doing 

- Contributing to core performance engineering initiatives from development to production, focusing on the delivery of impactful optimizations. Executing technical designs and plans for architectural and code-level performance improvements.

- Implementing foundational performance models and methodologies for complex, distributed systems.

- Supporting optimization strategies to ensure Elasticsearch remains performant, predictable, and scalable in diverse environments.

- Profiling and analyzing system behavior to identify bottlenecks in logging, metrics, vector search, and ES|QL.

- Ensuring robust performance benchmarks and regression detection for both stateful and stateless (Serverless) architectures.

- Collaborating with peers across the team to apply performance-focused development practices into new features.

- Contributing to automation efforts by building AI-assisted optimization harnesses that streamline profiling, hypothesis testing, and benchmarking.

- Providing technical guidance and peer reviews to other engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence.

What You Bring

- You have deep knowledge of Java internals and JVM memory management. You understand how concurrency models work. You can write code that is high-performance, thread-safe, and lock-free. This experience includes working with large open-source and enterprise codebases.

- You have proven experience in profiling and optimizing distributed systems. This includes deep experience with benchmarking tools (e.g., JMH, Rally), identifying performance regressions, and implementing algorithmic or hardware-aware optimizations.

- You have a solid comprehension of distributed systems architecture, including partition tolerance, cluster state propagation, and scaling challenges in large-scale data stores.

- You have a proven track record of using AI or advanced tooling to accelerate optimization, debug complex performance issues, and automate benchmarking workflows.

- You possess the ability to collaborate effectively within a team environment, contributing to the success of performance engineering goals.

- You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities

- You can work autonomously, drive decisions, and result in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.

Bonus Points

- Experience integrating high-performance native libraries (e.g., C++, Rust, SIMD-accelerated code) into Java applications.

- Deep knowledge of modern storage engine performance, index modes, or vector search optimizations.

- Experience defining and managing Performance SLAs and success criteria for distributed systems.

- Experience working on the internals of a large-scale data store or search engine.

- Experience working on the internals of a data store or search engine.

 Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component.

Get to know the team 
 Grab's Financial Services business is present across 6 countries in South East Asia, in the Payments, Lending, Insurance and Digital Banking domain. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.jd:
About Us 🚀

At Immutable, our mission is to drive the next evolution of gaming. One of the hardest part of  gaming is finding the players it deserves. Thousands of games launch every month, most never reach the audience they've already earned. That's the problem Immutable exists to solve, and it's why we built Audience, our growth platform for game studios. We're growing faster than we ever have, and we're hiring the talent who'll take it further. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Sydney, Australia. 


A bit about the role 🤔
Immutable is looking for a hands-on product engineer to build Audience, the MarTech platform that decides whether a game succeeds. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and data and you'll own outcomes, not just tasks.

 The work spans multiple initiatives including attribution and measurement (built from scratch, so studios can see which marketing actually drives players), engagement (a lifecycle and messaging engine built for games), AI growth (an AI CMO that audits a studio's marketing and recommends the next best action) and more.

You'll Be Empowered To (responsibilities) 🎮
- Own features end to end, from the customer problem through to shipping into a live product used by paying game studios

- Build attribution and measurement such as, click tracking, identity capture, install attribution, and conversion postbacks that work natively

- Shape Engage, our lifecycle and messaging engine across campaigns, journeys, segmentation, deliverability, and A/B testing

- Help build our AI CMO, and the orchestration layer that lets it beat a generic model by encoding real marketing expertise

- Work AI-native by default, using Cursor, Claude Code, and our own coding agents in the pull-request loop

- Work directly with Product, Design, Data, and our founders, and talk to the studios using what you build.

You may be a good fit if you 🤝:
- 4+ years of engineering experience in a product-driven environment

- Energised in an ambiguous environment

- Strong hands-on experience with TypeScript (both frontend and backend) and Golang is a must have 

- Empathy-driven communication and the ability to work across varied stakeholders

- Experience mentoring and sharing best practices with junior engineers

- Passion for user-first product development and operational excellence

- Start-up or Entrepreneurial experience is a plus

- Keen interest in Gaming and a willingness to learn fast

 Strong candidates may also have experience with: 

- Have built product at a marketing, growth, attribution, customer-data, or customer-engagement company, and terms like segments, attribution, user acquisition, CDP, CEP, lifecycle, and deliverability are second nature

- Have taken a product from 0 to 1, defining the first version and cutting scope yourself, and you think customer-problem-first

- Build with AI agents day to day, and have real opinions about where they help, where they don't, and when not to trust them

- Building and shipping AI or LLM-powered product features

 Our Stack: TypeScript, Go, Next.js and React, a BigQuery-based customer data platform, AWS and GCP, Kubernetes, and AI tooling including Cursor and Claude Code. We track our work in Linear.

 How we work: Small teams that own their outcomes. Fast iteration on CI/CD rather than big-bang releases. AI does the mechanical work so you can focus on judgement, taste and the customer.

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification above. The strongest candidates often bring an unexpected background, and we'd rather hear from you than have you rule yourself out. We build for a global community of players, and we want a team that reflects it.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer - Business Systems
jobs.location: New York City; Palo Alto; United States | New York, NY, United States
jobs.jd:
We are seeking a highly skilled Staff NetSuite Engineer with deep expertise in Order-to-Cash(O2C) & Record-to-Report (R2R) processes and accounting best practices. This role will serve as the technical and functional bridge between Finance and Technology, driving automation, process optimization, and scalability within our NetSuite environment.The successful candidate will lead the design, enhancement, and support of accounting systems that power our General Ledger (GL), Record-to-Report (R2R), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), including credit card process, Tax, and Treasury operations. As a senior member of the Finance Technology team, you will design and implement solutions that streamline accounting workflows, ensure compliance, and enhance financial reporting accuracy.

 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in New York City, NY or Palo Alto, CA or remotely in the United States.

Key Responsibilities

System Architecture & Development

- Lead the design, configuration, and customization of NetSuite to support R2R and accounting processes (GL, journals, allocations, consolidations, fixed assets, intercompany eliminations)

- Architect scalable NetSuite solutions that integrate seamlessly with upstream and downstream systems (e.g., procurement, billing, expense management, data lake)

- Develop and maintain SuiteScript, SuiteFlow, SuiteTalk (Web Services), and RESTlets to support automation and integrations

Process & Accounting Alignment

- Partner with Finance, Accounting, and Audit teams to translate accounting policies into system-enforced controls within NetSuite

- Act as the primary point of contact for Finance teams including Accounting, Tax, Treasury and RevOps

- Ensure compliance with SOX, GAAP, and audit requirements through configuration of role-based security, approvals, reconciliations, and audit trails

- Optimize financial close processes (journals, reconciliations, accruals, consolidations) to reduce close cycle time

- Build and enhance reporting frameworks (saved searches, financial reports, dashboards) to support accurate and timely financial reporting

- Support compliance and audit requirements through appropriate controls and documentation

jobs.jd:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.



We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.



Here’s what this particular role covers.



🛠️ About our AI Platform Team

Our AI Platform teams build the foundations that enable Wayve’s machine learning engineers and researchers to train, evaluate and deploy models at scale. Within the AI Libraries team, you’ll create high-quality platforms, tools and reusable abstractions that support thousands of GPUs and help accelerate the development of our autonomous-driving technology.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

You’ll work closely with machine learning teams to understand their workflows and turn complex requirements into stable, scalable and intuitive software. You’ll spend much of your time designing and writing Python, leading projects from discovery through delivery, improving engineering standards and supporting users as they push the scale and performance of their models.



🧩 What you’ll be working on

You’ll build modular libraries for areas such as multimodal data loading, distributed training and inference, checkpointing and observability. You’ll improve the reliability, performance and developer experience of systems used across Wayve, helping teams train models efficiently on large GPU clusters and work with camera, radar, lidar and other data sources.

 

🙌 You should apply if

You have extensive Python experience and a track record of designing, delivering and maintaining high-quality software systems at scale. You understand software architecture, testing and observability, and have experience with concurrent, parallel or distributed computing. Familiarity with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow and cloud environments—ideally Azure—is highly valuable. This is a software and platform engineering role rather than an ML modelling position.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

 - Recruiter screen 

 - Competency Interviews

 - Deep-dive technical interviews

 - Final interview

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.



If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

- You have operated stateful systems through rollouts, scaling events, incidents, and recovery. You know the difference between transient unavailability and incomplete or incorrect recovery, and when a system is safe to return to service.

- You've used deterministic simulation or another systematic method to uncover distributed-systems bugs that conventional tests missed.
